HTML → Figma

sinhaankur

Turn a live URL or pasted HTML into editable Figma layers — real frames, text and fills from the computed CSS. Runs on your device.

How to get the bookmarklet ▾
One-time setup: drag this button to your browser's bookmarks bar → ↝ Send to Figma
(or copy the code: copy bookmarklet)

Each time: 1) open your page in the browser so it fully renders · 2) click Send to Figma (it copies the layout) · 3) come back here and paste (⌘V) · 4) hit Import.

Best for simple static pages. For JS-rendered / bundled pages (Claude designs, SPAs) use Receive — it captures the page after it renders.

Many sites block cross-origin fetch, and JS-rendered pages won't render here. If it fails, use Receive.

Editable, not a screenshot. Each element becomes a real Figma layer positioned from its on-page box. Receive captures the live rendered page (handles JS/bundled designs + images); Paste HTML / From URL are for simple static pages. Free & open source — by sinhaankur.
